definitions.explanation: A separately ventilated room set aside for smoking inside an otherwise smoke-free building. Standard in Japanese offices, airports, stations, and hotels since indoor smoking restrictions tightened in 2020.

examples.japanese: {喫煙室|きつえんしつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どこ→どこ：00539_doko⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
⟦たばこ→たばこ：02909_tabako⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{喫煙室|きつえんしつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧お⟦{吸|す}い→吸う：04394_suu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please smoke in the smoking room.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{建物|たてもの}→建物：01458_tatemono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{喫煙室|きつえんしつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{三階|さんがい}→三階：27617_sangai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The smoking room in this building is on the third floor.

examples.japanese: {法改正|ほうかいせい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{飲食店|いんしょくてん}→飲食店：15093_inshokuten⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{喫煙室|きつえんしつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設|もう}ける→設ける：14220_moukeru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧{全面禁煙|ぜんめんきんえん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んだ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: With the change in the law, many restaurants chose between installing a smoking room and going completely smoke-free.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{喫煙|きつえん}→喫煙：17580_kitsuen⟧ (smoking) + ⟦{室|しつ}→室：09946_shitsu⟧ (room). Appears on signage everywhere in Japan, so it is worth recognizing at a glance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {喫煙室|きつえんしつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{利用|りよう}する→利用する：21735_riyousuru⟧: to use the smoking room
- {喫煙室|きつえんしつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設|もう}ける→設ける：14220_moukeru⟧: to install a smoking room
- ⟦{分煙|ぶんえん}→分煙：20832_bunen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{喫煙室|きつえんしつ}: a smoking room for separating smokers and non-smokers

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{喫煙所|きつえんじょ}→喫煙所：07043_kitsuenjo⟧: smoking area — may be outdoors or merely partitioned, not necessarily a room
- ⟦{禁煙|きんえん}→禁煙：02644_kinen⟧: no smoking; quitting smoking — the sign you see far more often
- ⟦{分煙|ぶんえん}→分煙：20832_bunen⟧: segregation of smoking and non-smoking areas
